title: SearchDone
description: Terminal reply to search: every nameMatches batch has been sent. Codes only; the UI words the notices.

outcomeCode.description: How the search ended, when that needs saying: noMatches when it finished having sent no match (EARS-03). Absent otherwise; listed in codes.json outcomeCodes.

notices.description: Notice codes to show with the results; none until Story 2.3.

indexVersion.description: The Index the results came from; null until content search arrives.

indexingActive.description: Whether documents were still being read while the search ran.
